notes.title: Loot box upgrades and some bugfix
notes.notes:
2018-12-21 [v 0.48.1221 Early Access 1 Alpha(wip)]
 • Bug fixes : Resources can be destroyed by right mouse click
 • Bug fixes : Item name not translated in stack divider dialog
 + From now : You can not open loot boxes if you does not have 5 free slots in inventory
 + From now : You can add additional slots in your personal box
 + New achievements
! Wood icon changed

notes.title: Bug fixes day 2
notes.notes:
2018-12-17 [v 0.48.1217 Early Access 1 Alpha(wip)]
 + From now containers panel automatically hide when you outside safe platform
 + From now you can view containers in inventory
 + "Savant Vigil" perk activated : Savant increase max HP each time when zombie die near him
 + New Achievements for hard boss killing
 + New Achievements for engineering
 • Bug fixes : Dissasemble not gain EXP + ingeneering skill upgrade
 • Bug fixes : Upgrades not gain EXP + ingeneering skill upgrade
 • Bug fixes : Floating texts was starting in wrong place
 ! Pistol and Rifle bullets repainted for better visual recognition
 • Bug fixes : Wrong killing rating
 + From now Engineering improvements need more goods
 + From now Right click on bullets in inventory now combine stacks

notes.title: Bug fixes day
notes.notes:
2018-12-16 [v 0.48.1216 Early Access 1 Alpha(wip)]
 • Bug fixes : Some times character not loaded correctly
 + Now cursor changes to exclamation or question, when you hovering Qest Giver in game world.
 • Bug fixes : In engineering dialog was enabled extra keerning
 • Bug fixes : Grenade prediction still enabled when you die
 • Bug fixes : Proper level display in stats panel, when your character was loaded 
 • Bug fixes : When player re-opening inventory, all previously opened windows will be closed
 • Bug fixes : Difficulty experience bonus no longer affects on exp received by upgrading or disassembling item
 • Bug fixes : Stats progress on healing
 • Bug fixes : Stats progress on receiving damage
 • Bug fixes : When you return to the main menu, the character level is not properly updated.
 • Bug fixes : Wrong elements transcription after restart game with another language.
 • Loot : Silver loot lowered by 2 times
 • Bug fixes : Survival window language not changing properly
 • Bug fixes : Blood position corrected

notes.title: Bugfixes and new Grenade throwing system.
notes.notes:
2018-12-14 [v 0.38.1214 Early Access 1 Alpha(wip)]
 • Bug fixes : Camera movement loose 1 frame movement iteration
 • Bug fixes : Some times grenade explodes too quick
 • Now "Throw grenade" [Right Mouse Button] will activate "Grenade Throw Prediction" on first "button UP", on second "button UP" - throwing grenade.
 • "Prediction" will disabled when you use any other action :
[list]
[*] Start shooting
[*] Complete grenade throw
[*] Use medic box
[*] Sharing or Giving bullets
[/list]
 • "Prediction" are not disabled when you change weapon
+ New Steam achievements

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33931813/7db3e6a32c6ad91bf23b024c33515e5faf1d2b5f.png[/img]
